div.head: II As 14
div.ab: Be myneterum. We cwædon, þæt án mynet sy ofer ealle ðæs cynges anwealde; ⁊ nán man ne mynetige butan port.
Be myneterum. Þridda: þæt an mynet sy ofer eall ðæs cynges onweald; ⁊ nan mon ne mynetige buton (on) port.
[Be myneterum.] Þridde: þæt an mynet sie ofer [ealle] þæs cinges anweald; ⁊ nan man ne mynetige butan port.
De monetariis. Placuit nobis, ut una moneta sit in totum regis imperium (regno nostro); et nemo (nullus) monetet extra portum.
Be myneterum. Ðridda: þæt an mynet sy ofer eall ðæs cynges onweald ⁊ nan mon ne mynetige buton on port.
Thirdly: we declare that there shall be one coinage throughout the king's realm, and no man shall mint money except in a town.
Concerning moneyers. Thirdly, that there is to be one coinage over all the king’s dominion, and no one is to mint money except in a town.
Von Münzern. Drittens (Wir bestimmten Ld): dass Eine Münze über des Königs ganzes Gebiet hin sei; und niemand münze ausser in einer Stadt.
Of moneyers. Thirdly (We determined, Ld): that there be one coinage throughout all the king's dominion; and that no one mint except in a town.
